title: Suspension & Shock / Strut Check
subtitle: Clunks, bounce, and nose-dive — driveway tests first, then honest shop calls for springs and struts.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel, step feedback Yes/No. Phase 3 suspension: bounce test DIY; spring compressors = shop.

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Air suspension faults need scan data and specialty tools — don't DIY air lines casually.
Past 80k, bushings and sway links often clunk before shocks are fully dead.
Trucks that haul: check rear shocks and leaf bushings — squat and bounce tell stories.
